programs.title: Smoke \u0026 Steel
programs.desc: The industrial revolution changed the world.Although often unconsciously, we still benefit from the achievements of this era - groundbreaking designs, inventions and discoveries.One of them is the excavation of a tunnel under the Thames.The success of this venture initiated the construction of underground structures.Urban planning works in Prague had a huge impact on the rapid development of European cities.In turn, the creation of planetary observatories changed human perception of the universe.The use of steam engines had an impact on many areas of life, including:for the development of transport and tourism.The Trans-Siberian Railway, a desperate attempt to connect the east and west of the great Russian territory, had an impact on the outcome of the war, and a warship off the southern coast of England contributed to a change in naval warfare tactics.The program presents not only those structures that are still in use, but also those that are historical attractions.
